question: In a magnetised material, the magnetic intensity is $2.0\times 10^3\text{ A m}^{-1}$ and the magnetisation is $1.5\times 10^3\text{ A m}^{-1}$ in the same direction. Find the magnetic field inside the material.

options.B: $4.4\times10^{-3}\text{ T}$, along the common direction of $\vec{H}$ and $\vec{M}$.
options.C: $4.4\times10^{-4}\text{ T}$, along the common direction of $\vec{H}$ and $\vec{M}$.
options.D: $1.4\times10^{-3}\text{ T}$, along the common direction of $\vec{H}$ and $\vec{M}$.
